question: arXiv:2610.26648v1 studies cascade annihilation of dark matter through on-shell scalar mediators, χχ → φφ, with the mass ratio r = m_φ/m_χ. In the 4τ channel, how does the dark matter mass preferred by the Galactic Center excess change as r is lowered from 1, and which kinematic explanation does the paper suggest for the change of direction? Give the relation it states for the value of r at which the τ-energy range is widest, and the value of r it quotes for m_χ ≃ 15 GeV.
reference_answer: As r is reduced, the mass preferred by the excess first decreases, down to r ≈ 0.5, and then increases again at smaller r; at intermediate r the mediated cascade prefers smaller masses than the effective χχ → 4τ benchmark. The first shift toward smaller masses is consistent with the change of the photon spectrum caused by the mediator boost. The change of direction may be related to the competition between the mediator boost and the finite τ mass: for a scalar mediator the τ energy is uniformly distributed between E± = (m_χ/2)[1 ± √(1−r²)·√(1−4m_τ²/(r²m_χ²))], and at fixed m_χ this range is widest at r = √(2m_τ/m_χ), which is r ≃ 0.49 for m_χ ≃ 15 GeV, close to the value at which the preferred region turns toward larger masses. The paper offers this as a possible, qualitative explanation, because the photon spectrum also depends on the subsequent τ decays.

numbers.label: r of the widest tau-energy range for m_chi ~ 15 GeV

wrong_numbers.label: r of the slight bend in the 4b channel (footnote), another channel

by_hand: the preferred mass first decreases as r is lowered (down to about 0.5) and increases again at smaller r
explanation: competition of the mediator boost and the finite tau mass; the tau-energy range is widest at r = sqrt(2 m_tau / m_chi)

accept_note: 필수: (1) r 을 줄이면 선호 질량이 r ≈ 0.5 까지 줄었다가 더 작은 r 에서 다시 커진다, (2) 매개입자 boost 와 τ 질량의 경쟁으로 설명하며 τ 에너지 범위가 r = √(2m_τ/m_χ) 에서 가장 넓다, (3) m_χ ≃ 15 GeV 에서 r ≃ 0.49. E± 식, 'effective 4τ 보다 작은 질량', 'τ 붕괴도 스펙트럼에 영향'은 없어도 됨. 논문이 '가능한 설명'으로 조심스럽게 썼으므로 단정했는지는 따지지 않음. 4b 채널의 r ≃ 0.4(각주)를 τ 의 값으로 답하면 오답.

notes.evidence: 6.3(25,531자)의 14,648–15,426자. 첫 호출이 주는 조각(0–19,837자) 안이고, 피할 것으로 정한 19,837자 뒤쪽은 쓰지 않음. 6 전체(38,025자)로 읽으면 anchor 가 27,829자에 있어 두 번째 호출에서 나옴. anchor 는 저장소의 parser 4 로 원고(tests/fixtures)를 나눠 확인함.
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록에는 4τ 선호 질량의 r 의존성도 0.49 도 없음.
notes.grading: r = √(2m_τ/m_χ) 는 E± 식에서 유도할 수 있지만, 선호 질량이 r ≈ 0.5 부근에서 방향을 바꾼다는 것은 이 논문의 맞춤 결과라 읽지 않고는 답할 수 없음. 본문은 이 문단에서 그림의 패널을 가리키지만 답은 글로 닫혀 있고, 질문에는 그림을 가리키는 표현을 넣지 않았음.

question: arXiv:2610.26648v1 repeats its Galactic Center fit with FRONT+BACK events instead of the FRONT-only events of the main analysis. Between which values does the ratio of the FRONT+BACK to the FRONT excess intensity lie above 0.78 GeV, by how much is the FRONT+BACK intensity lower in the four lowest-energy bins, and why does the paper say that this low-energy offset is more significant than the quoted deviations suggest?
reference_answer: For diffuse-emission Model X, above 0.78 GeV the ratio lies between 0.92 and 1.06 in all bins, within about 1σ, and its weighted mean over the 14 common bins is 1.00. In the four lowest-energy bins (0.275–0.784 GeV) the FRONT+BACK intensity is lower by 9–18%; each bin deviates by less than 2σ (at most 1.7σ), but all four in the same direction. Because the FRONT events are a subset of the FRONT+BACK sample, the two spectra are positively correlated and the uncertainties of the ratio, which were added in quadrature, are overestimated; the offset is therefore more significant than these numbers suggest.

numbers.label: lower end of the ratio above 0.78 GeV
upper end of the ratio above 0.78 GeV
smallest deficit in the four lowest bins
largest deficit in the four lowest bins

by_hand: reason: the FRONT events are a subset of the FRONT+BACK sample, so the two spectra are positively correlated and the uncertainties of the ratio are overestimated

accept_note: 필수: 0.78 GeV 위에서 비가 0.92–1.06, 가장 낮은 네 구간에서 FRONT+BACK 이 9–18% 낮음, 이유(FRONT 사건이 FRONT+BACK 표본의 부분집합 → 두 스펙트럼이 양의 상관 → 비의 오차가 과대평가됨). '약 1σ 이내', 가중평균 1.00, 각 구간 2σ 미만(최대 1.7σ), 네 구간이 모두 같은 방향이라는 것은 없어도 됨. 이유를 PSF 나 점광원 오염처럼 다른 것으로 답하면 오답.

notes.evidence: C(3,739자)의 2,773–3,470자. 한 번에 나옴. anchor 는 저장소의 parser 4 로 원고(tests/fixtures)를 나눠 확인함.
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록에 FRONT+BACK 비교가 없음.

question: In arXiv:2112.09706v2, the Galactic diffuse emission models differ in the assumed magnetic field, interstellar radiation field and gas, which changes how the inverse-Compton templates evolve with energy. According to the paper, how much does the morphology of the inverse-Compton templates change between 1 GeV and 10 GeV — in which sky regions and for which models are the two extremes it quotes — and at what level can the template models still differ after the fitting procedure?
reference_answer: Comparing the inverse-Compton emission at 10 GeV with that at 1 GeV, the paper finds that the shape of the templates changes by no more than a few per cent in the regions of the Fermi Bubbles (the case it quotes is Model I) and by more than 40% along the Galactic disk (the case it quotes is Model XV). After the fit, differences of order 10% still remain between the template models.

numbers.label: largest deformation, along the Galactic disk

by_hand: within a few per cent in the Bubbles regions for Model I, and more than 40% along the Galactic disk for Model XV: not the other way round
after the fit the template models still differ at the level of about 10%

accept_note: 필수: Bubbles 영역에서는 수 % 이내(Model I), 은하 원반을 따라서는 40% 초과(Model XV), 맞춤 뒤에도 모형 사이 차이가 ~10% 수준. 자기장 범위(B0 2.5–20 μG 등)는 묻지 않았으므로 없어도 됨. 두 극단의 영역이나 모형을 바꿔 쓰면 오답. 첫 조각에서 끊긴 문장(Bubbles 쪽의 ‘수 % 이내’)까지만 답하면 오답.

notes.evidence: 3.2(21,543자)의 20,000자 뒤. 이어 읽어야 나옴: 근거 문장이 20,000자 경계에 걸쳐 있어 첫 호출은 Bubbles 쪽의 ‘수 % 이내’를 말하는 줄에서 끊기고(19,943자 부근), 40%·Model XV·O(10%) 는 그 뒤에 있음. anchor 는 2026-11-17 read_section 으로 LaTeX 원문에서 확인함(위치는 eval.check 로 확인할 것).
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록에 템플릿 사이의 차이를 말하는 수치가 없음.
notes.grading: 본문이 이 문장에서 그림의 좌·우 패널을 가리키지만 수치·영역·모형 이름이 글로 적혀 있음. O(10%) 는 '10 GeV' 의 10 과 규칙으로 가릴 수 없어 사람이 확인.

question: arXiv:2209.00006v2 compares the best-fit spectra of its Galactic Center excess candidates when each is fitted together with ring-based templates. Which candidate gives the faintest excess, and how good is its fit? What does the paper say about the spectra of the candidates that include the boxy bulge? And how does the dark matter spectrum obtained with the ring-based templates compare with those spectra and with the dark matter result obtained with the astrophysics-based templates of Cholis et al.?
reference_answer: The X-shaped bulge yields the faintest excess and is also the worst-fitting candidate. Every candidate that contains the boxy bulge (alone, with the nuclear stellar bulge added, or varying together with the X-shaped bulge) ends up with nearly the same spectrum, a comparatively soft one, which the authors read as the template having absorbed diffuse flux that the model lacks. The dark matter spectrum obtained with ring-based templates is on average harder than those; in shape it resembles the dark matter result found with the astrophysics-based templates, but its flux is lower, and it has bin-to-bin “wiggles” that neither dark matter annihilation nor millisecond pulsars would produce.

phrases.label: the dark matter spectrum is harder

by_hand: the X-shaped bulge also gives the worst fit
the candidates that include the boxy bulge have very similar spectra
the ring-based dark matter spectrum is similar in shape to the result with the astrophysics-based templates but lower in flux
wiggles between energy bins that neither dark matter annihilation nor millisecond pulsars predict

accept_note: 필수: 가장 약한 초과는 X-shaped bulge(맞춤도 가장 나쁨), boxy bulge 를 포함한 후보들은 스펙트럼이 서로 매우 비슷하고 상대적으로 soft, 고리 템플릿과 함께 맞춘 DM 스펙트럼은 평균적으로 더 hard 하며 천체물리 기반 템플릿의 DM 결과와 모양은 비슷하나 flux 가 낮음. ‘wiggles’(DM 소멸도 MSP 도 예측하지 않는 구간 사이의 요동)는 있으면 좋으나 없어도 됨. 고리 템플릿 자체의 스펙트럼(둘째·셋째 고리 등)은 묻지 않았음.

notes.evidence: 0(29,791자)의 20,900자 뒤(한 문단). 이어 읽어야 나옴: 첫 조각은 19,840자에서 끝남. anchor 는 2026-11-17 read_section 으로 LaTeX 원문에서 확인함(위치는 eval.check 로 확인할 것).
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록은 χ² 와 Bayesian evidence 의 차이만 말함.
notes.grading: 문단이 그림을 소개하며 시작하지만 답은 모두 글로 적혀 있음.

question: arXiv:1005.5480v3 tests the uniformity of the Fermi bubble spectrum by splitting the bubble template into a north and a south bubble, and it also repeats the template fit with the Haslam 408 MHz map in place of the simple disk model as the inverse-Compton template. According to the paper, which of the two bubbles comes out with the slightly harder spectrum, and to what is this attributed? Why is the Haslam map not an ideal tracer of the inverse-Compton emission, and how does the fitted bubble spectrum change when it is used?
reference_answer: The northern bubble comes out slightly harder than the southern one. The authors put this down to Loop I: its template, whose spectrum is softer, is fitted only in the northern sky. Either bubble is still harder than all the other fitted components, and the overall conclusion stays that the bubbles are north–south symmetric and spectrally uniform. As for the Haslam 408 MHz map, it shows the bright Loop I structure and mostly traces synchrotron radiation of softer electrons (around 1 GeV), whereas inverse-Compton emission is set by the electron distribution together with the interstellar radiation field. When it is used, the bubble spectrum is still the hardest component, but its correlation coefficients are raised at low energies, below about 2 GeV.

by_hand: the north bubble, not the south one, has the slightly harder spectrum, because the softer Loop I template is fitted in the northern sky
Haslam map: a bright Loop I feature, and synchrotron emission from softer electrons of about 1 GeV, while inverse-Compton emission depends on both the electron and the radiation-field distributions
with the Haslam map the bubble spectrum stays harder than the other components but is enhanced below about 2 GeV

accept_note: 필수: (1) 북쪽 버블이 약간 더 hard — 북쪽 하늘에 스펙트럼이 더 soft 한 Loop I 템플릿을 함께 맞추기 때문, (2) Haslam 지도는 Loop I 의 밝은 구조를 담고 있고 ~1 GeV 의 더 soft 한 전자의 싱크로트론 방출이 지배하므로(IC 는 전자와 ISRF 분포 둘 다에 의존) IC 의 좋은 추적자가 아님, (3) Haslam 을 쓰면 버블 스펙트럼은 여전히 다른 성분보다 hard 하지만 ≲ 2 GeV 에서 상관 계수가 커짐. 첫 조각 본문의 결론(남북 대칭, 공간·스펙트럼으로 균일)만 답하고 위 내용이 없으면 오답.

notes.evidence: 3.2(30,666자)의 18,928자 뒤. 이어 읽어야 나옴. 두 번째 조각은 그림 설명문과 표뿐이고, 근거 두 문장은 버블을 나눈 맞춤의 그림 설명문과 Haslam 맞춤의 그림 설명문에 글로 적혀 있음. 첫 조각(0–18,928자)의 본문은 ‘버블은 남북 대칭이고 공간과 스펙트럼이 균일하며, 이 결론은 원반 IC 템플릿의 선택에 거의 달려 있지 않다’는 결론만 말함. anchor 는 2026-11-17 read_section 으로 LaTeX 원문에서 확인함(위치는 eval.check 로 확인할 것).
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록에 남북 차이도 Haslam 지도도 없음.
notes.grading: 근거가 그림 설명문 안에 있어 답에 ‘그림은 보지 못했다’는 단서가 붙을 수 있음. 답 자체는 글로 닫혀 있으므로 그 단서만으로 감점하지 않음. 설명문 근거를 쓰지 않으려면 이 문항을 다른 긴 조각의 문항으로 바꿀 것.

question: In their study of the background model systematics for the Fermi GeV excess, Calore, Cholis and Weniger discuss the energy spectrum of the excess at sub-GeV energies. Which spectral shape do they say dark matter annihilation into b b̄ predicts at low energies, and what do they conclude about the measured spectrum below 1 GeV? Give the low-energy slopes of their broken power-law fit and of their power-law fit with an exponential cutoff.
reference_answer: Annihilation into b b̄ is expected to give a power law that rises with an index of about 1.5 and then cuts off sharply above roughly 0.05 m_χ; measuring that shape precisely would count strongly in favour of dark matter. The authors find that the measured spectrum does rise below 1 GeV, with an index harder than about 2, and that this holds out to latitudes of 5°–10° and beyond. Their fitted low-energy slopes are α₁ = 1.42 (+0.22/−0.31) for the broken power law and α = 0.945 (+0.36/−0.5) for the power law with exponential cutoff; they link the harder of the two to the emission above 10 GeV. They regard their sub-GeV results as reliable and the b b̄ spectrum as fully compatible with the data.

numbers.label: low-energy slope of the broken power law
slope of the power law with exponential cutoff
spectral index predicted for b b-bar

wrong_numbers.label: high-energy slope of the broken power law, not the low-energy one
break energy of the abstract, not a slope

by_hand: b b-bar prediction: a rising power law with a pronounced cutoff above about 0.05 m_chi
measured spectrum: a rise below 1 GeV with a spectral index harder than about 2

accept_note: 필수: b b̄ 는 지수 ~1.5 의 상승하는 멱법칙과 ~0.05 m_χ 위의 뚜렷한 cutoff, 측정된 스펙트럼은 1 GeV 아래에서 지수 ~2 보다 hard 하게 상승, α₁ = 1.42, α = 0.945. 오차, 위도 5°–10° 까지 이어지는 경향, ‘10 GeV 위 방출과 관련’, b b̄ 가 자료와 일치한다는 것은 없어도 됨. α₂ = 2.63 이나 E_break 를 저에너지 기울기로 답하면 오답.

notes.evidence: 6.3(2,479자) 전체가 근거. 한 번에 나옴. α₁ 과 α 의 값은 5.3 의 본문과 표에도 있으나, b b̄ 의 예측 모양과 ‘1 GeV 아래의 상승’이라는 결론은 6.3 에만 있음. anchor 는 2026-11-17 read_section 으로 LaTeX 원문에서 확인함(위치는 eval.check 로 확인할 것).
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록에는 E_break = 2.1 ± 0.2 GeV 와 b b̄ 의 질량만 있음.
notes.search: 질문에 1409.0042 가 없음. search_papers("background model systematics Fermi GeV excess") → 15건 가운데 1409.0042v1 이 1순위(2026-11-17). 2순위 1411.4647v2, 3순위 1502.02805v1(같은 세 저자의 발표문)이 헷갈릴 수 있는 논문.

question: In arXiv:1511.08787v2, how do the antiproton bounds on dark matter annihilating into b quarks through multi-step cascades change when the number of cascade steps is increased, and what reason does the paper give? How large is the effect of the choice of propagation model, and how do the bounds obtained with the more conservative propagation model compare with those from the Fermi dwarf galaxies?
reference_answer: More cascade steps make the antiproton bounds tighter once the dark matter is heavier than about 20 GeV. The paper's reason: the p̄/p measurements are far more precise and numerous below 10 GeV, and each extra step moves the antiprotons of a given dark matter mass to lower energies, into that well-measured range. Switching between the two propagation models (KRA and THN) moves the bounds by as much as a factor of ten, the THN ones (thin diffusion zone, z_t = 0.5; small diffusion coefficient, D₀ = 0.32×10²⁸ cm²/s) being the weaker. Yet for many-step cascades even THN beats the Fermi dwarf limits at low masses: the paper's example is below about 100 GeV for n ≥ 4.

numbers.label: mass above which more steps strengthen the bound
mass below which the THN bound is stronger than the dwarfs for n >= 4

by_hand: more steps make the bound stronger, not weaker, because the p-bar/p data are more precise and abundant below 10 GeV and more steps shift the antiproton spectrum down in energy
propagation model: up to an order of magnitude, with the THN bounds the weaker ones
even the THN bound is stronger than the Fermi dwarf limits below about 100 GeV for n >= 4

accept_note: 필수: 단계 수가 늘면 ~20 GeV 보다 무거운 DM 에서 반양성자 한계가 강해진다, 이유(p̄/p 자료가 10 GeV 아래에서 더 정밀하고 많으며 단계가 늘면 스펙트럼이 낮은 에너지로 옮겨 감), 전파 모형에 따라 한 자릿수까지 달라지고 THN 쪽이 더 약함, 그 THN 으로도 n ≥ 4 에서 ~100 GeV 아래는 Fermi dwarf 한계보다 강함. z_t 와 D₀ 의 값, 쓴 실험(BESS·CAPRICE·PAMELA), ε_f = 0.3 은 없어도 됨. ‘단계가 늘면 한계가 약해진다’는 답은 오답.

notes.evidence: 8(5,932자). 한 번에 나옴. anchor 는 2026-11-17 read_section 으로 LaTeX 원문에서 확인함(위치는 eval.check 로 확인할 것).
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록은 CMB·dwarf·AMS-02 양전자 한계만 요약하고 반양성자 한계의 경향은 없음.

question: arXiv:1410.3696v1 derives the isotropic diffuse gamma-ray background with three reference foreground models, A, B and C. Why do the authors go beyond the class of Galactic diffuse emission models studied before, to which model A belongs, and in what do models B and C differ from model A?
reference_answer: Model A belongs to the previously studied class, which assumes one diffusion coefficient for the whole Galaxy and a single source population for electrons and nuclei (following the pulsar distribution). With models of that class the inverse-Compton template does not behave consistently in the multi-component fit: the fitted inverse-Compton spectrum differs from the one the model predicts. If the cause is a wrong sky distribution of the inverse-Compton intensity, the isotropic template can soak up part of the error, and the isotropic background would come out biased. The authors therefore add two models with more freedom. Model B has a separate, electron-only source population near the Galactic center that produces most of the inverse-Compton emission (plus a local source of soft electrons for the electron spectrum measured at Earth below 20 GV). Model C makes the diffusion coefficient and the re-acceleration strength depend on Galactocentric radius and height, and concentrates the sources more toward the center than the pulsar distribution. All three include re-acceleration; A is the baseline but is not treated as preferred.

by_hand: reason: inverse-Compton templates of the earlier model class gave a spectrum inconsistent with the fit, so the isotropic template could compensate and bias the isotropic background
model B: an additional electron-only source population near the Galactic center that produces most of the inverse-Compton emission
model C: diffusion coefficient (and re-acceleration) varying with Galactocentric radius and height, sources more centrally peaked

accept_note: 필수: (1) 이유 — 이전 모형군(확산 계수 일정, 전자와 핵의 광원 분포 동일)의 IC 템플릿은 맞춤에서 얻은 IC 스펙트럼과 맞지 않아, 등방 템플릿이 그 부정확을 메우며 IGRB 를 치우치게 할 수 있음, (2) B — 은하 중심 근처의 전자 전용 추가 광원 분포(IC 의 대부분을 냄), (3) C — 확산 계수(와 재가속)가 은하 중심 거리와 높이에 따라 변함(광원은 pulsar 분포보다 중심에 몰림). B 의 국소 soft 전자 광원(20 GV 아래), δ = 0.33, A 가 기준이지만 선호 모형은 아니라는 것은 없어도 됨. B 와 C 를 바꿔 쓰면 오답.

question: arXiv:2610.26648v1 builds the systematic covariance matrix of its Galactic Center spectrum from control regions along the Galactic plane, as the earlier template analysis by Cholis, Zhong, McDermott and Surdutovich did, but it treats the principal components of that matrix differently. How many principal components does each analysis keep in the covariance matrix it fits with, and what reason does each give? What does each quote for the share of the first three components, and what does the earlier paper report about its fits when fewer components are kept?
reference_answer: Cholis et al. (arXiv:2112.09706v2, Sec. 6.2) keep only the three leading principal components. Their weights add up to about 0.99, i.e. the truncated matrix reproduces the full one to 99%. The stated purpose is to drop the small eigenvalues, attributed to noise, so that inverting the matrix is more stable. They add that the fits do not change when three or more components are used, whereas with two or fewer they get much worse in every case. arXiv:2610.26648v1 (Sec. 3.5) keeps the full 14×14 empirical covariance matrix, all 14 eigenmodes (numerical rank 14), without PCA truncation: the first component carries 94.2% of the total variance and the first three together 98.95% (approximately 99%), but these fractions are reported as diagnostics only, because a high retained variance does not by itself establish that the discarded modes are noise or that truncation leaves the spectral-fit results unchanged.

phrases.label: three components kept by Cholis et al.

by_hand: three components belong to Cholis et al. and the full matrix (14 modes) to arXiv:2610.26648v1, not the other way round
Cholis et al.: small eigenvalues are likely noise and truncation makes the inversion more robust; fits robust with three or more components, substantially worse with two or fewer
arXiv:2610.26648v1: 98.95% (about 99%) in the first three components, but a high retained variance does not show that the discarded modes are noise or that truncation leaves the fit unchanged

accept_note: 필수: Cholis 등은 처음 3개 주성분만 남김(원래 행렬을 99% 정확도로 재현; 작은 고유값은 잡음일 가능성이 커서 없애면 역행렬이 더 안정) — 3개 이상이면 맞춤이 안정적이고 2개 이하이면 맞춤 품질이 크게 나빠짐 / 본인 논문은 14×14 전체(14개 모드, rank 14)를 자르지 않고 씀 — 처음 3개가 98.95%(‘약 99%’ 로 써도 됨)이지만 진단용일 뿐이고, 남긴 분산의 비율이 높다고 버린 모드가 잡음이라거나 맞춤 결과가 변하지 않는다는 뜻은 아니기 때문. 첫 성분 94.2% 는 없어도 됨. 두 논문의 처리를 바꿔 쓰면 오답.

question: arXiv:2610.26648v1 quotes a J-factor integrated over its Galactic Center fitting region, while Elor, Rodd and Slatyer, in their paper on multi-step cascade annihilations of dark matter and the Galactic Center excess, quote a J-factor averaged over their region of interest. Give both values together with the region each refers to and the solid angle of the fitting region of arXiv:2610.26648v1, and say whether the two values agree once they are put on the same footing.
reference_answer: arXiv:2610.26648v1 (Sec. 3.6): J_ann(ΔΩ) = 8.86×10²² GeV² cm⁻⁵, integrated over the 40°×40° square with |b| > 2°, whose solid angle is ΔΩ = 0.429 sr. Elor, Rodd and Slatyer (arXiv:1503.01773v2, Sec. 2): J_norm ≈ 2.0618×10²³ GeV² cm⁻⁵, the J-factor averaged over |l| ≤ 20°, 2° ≤ |b| ≤ 20°, which is the same region. Dividing the integrated value by the solid angle gives 8.86×10²²/0.429 ≈ 2.07×10²³ GeV² cm⁻⁵ per steradian (equivalently, 2.0618×10²³ × 0.429 ≈ 8.85×10²² GeV² cm⁻⁵), so the two agree to about 0.2%. Both use a generalized NFW profile with γ = 1.2, r_s = 20 kpc and a Sun–Galactic Center distance of 8.5 kpc, normalized to 0.4 GeV cm⁻³ (the local density in arXiv:2610.26648v1, where ρ_s = 0.271 GeV cm⁻³).

solid angle of the region
J-factor of Elor, Rodd and Slatyer, averaged over the region

concludes that they agree, to well below 1% (about 0.2%); comparing the raw numbers and finding a factor of two is wrong

question: Kim, Lee and Shin proposed in 2008 a renormalizable model of singlet fermionic dark matter, in which a gauge-singlet Dirac fermion ψ couples to the Standard Model through the mixing of a real singlet scalar with the Higgs boson. For their parameter set with Higgs masses m_h1 = 90 GeV and m_h2 = 500 GeV: which condition do they impose from the LEP2 Higgs searches, for which dark matter masses does the region allowed by the relic abundance satisfy it and why, and what do the direct-detection experiments of that time imply for this LEP2-allowed region?

items.anchor: contribution from the invisible Higgs decay

reference_answer: They require ξ² < 0.1, a conservative LEP2 bound for a 90 GeV Higgs boson, where ξ_i² = (g_{h_i ZZ}/g_{HZZ}^{SM})² · Γ^{SM}_{h_i}/(Γ^{SM}_{h_i} + Γ(h_i → ψ̄ψ)) contains the invisible width. Of the points with the right relic abundance, only those with m_ψ below about m_h1/2 (≈ 45 GeV) pass, because there the invisible decay h₁ → ψ̄ψ is open and lowers ξ₁²; above m_h1/2 that decay is kinematically closed, ξ₁² equals cos²θ and always exceeds 0.1, so LEP2 rules those points out. The direct-detection section then shows that this LEP2-allowed region is ruled out completely by the limits of the time, from CDMS and XENON.

numbers.label: upper bound on xi^2 for a 90 GeV Higgs boson

wrong_numbers.label: bound used for a 100 GeV Higgs boson, not for 90 GeV

by_hand: allowed only for m_psi below about m_h1/2 (about 45 GeV), where the decay h1 -> psi-bar psi is open
the LEP2-allowed region is entirely excluded by direct detection, not merely constrained

accept_note: 필수: ξ² < 0.1(90 GeV), m_ψ ≲ m_h1/2(≈ 45 GeV)에서만 허용 — 보이지 않는 붕괴 h₁ → ψ̄ψ 가 ξ² 를 줄이기 때문(그 위에서는 ξ₁² = cos²θ > 0.1), 그 LEP2 허용 영역은 CDMS 와 XENON 의 직접 검출 한계로 모두 배제됨. ξ² 의 정의식은 없어도 됨. (m_h1, m_h2) = (120, 500), (120, 100) GeV 의 결과(공명 골짜기는 배제되지 않음)를 이 매개변수 집합의 결과로 답하면 오답.

question: Both Calore, Cholis and Weniger (arXiv:1409.0042v1) and the Fermi-LAT Collaboration (arXiv:1704.03910v2) estimate how well the Galactic diffuse emission is modeled by fitting a dark-matter-like template in control regions along the Galactic plane, away from the Galactic Center. For each paper: at which longitudes is the template placed, and how are the results of these fits turned into a systematic uncertainty for the Galactic Center? For arXiv:1409.0042v1, also give the number of regions fitted and the number that enters the uncertainty estimate.
reference_answer: arXiv:1409.0042v1 (Sec. 4.2): the excess template is moved along the disk in steps of 5° and centered at ℓ = k·5°, k = −14, …, 14, i.e. 29 overlapping regions (−20° + k·5° ≤ ℓ ≤ 20° + k·5°, 2° ≤ |b| ≤ 20°) covering |ℓ| ≤ 90°, each fitted with all 60 diffuse-emission models. The residuals absorbed by the transposed template in the 22 test regions at 20° ≤ |ℓ| ≤ 70° give a covariance matrix in energy bins — the empirical model systematics, analysed through its principal components — which enters the spectral fits. arXiv:1704.03910v2 (Sec. 9.1): the gNFW template is shifted in steps of 10° in longitude at b = 0 for 30° ≤ l ≤ 330°, and the spatial template is fitted together with a dark matter annihilation spectrum. The best-fit signal is expressed as a fraction f = N_sig/b_eff of the effective background; δf_GP, the value of f that is exceeded in only 16% of the fits along the plane (a one-sided 1σ level), is taken as the systematic uncertainty, δN_sig,syst = b_eff × δf_syst.

numbers.label: regions fitted in arXiv:1409.0042v1
test regions in the covariance matrix of arXiv:1409.0042v1

by_hand: arXiv:1409.0042v1: template centered at l = k x 5 deg over |l| <= 90 deg; the 22 regions at 20 <= |l| <= 70 deg give the covariance matrix
arXiv:1704.03910v2: steps of 10 deg at b = 0 for 30 <= l <= 330 deg; signal as a fraction of the effective background; the value exceeded in 16% of the fits is the systematic uncertainty
the two methods are not swapped

accept_note: 필수: 1409.0042v1 — ℓ = k·5°(k = −14…14, |ℓ| ≤ 90°)의 29개 영역을 맞추고, 20° ≤ |ℓ| ≤ 70° 의 22개 시험 영역의 잔차로 에너지 구간 사이의 공분산 행렬을 만듦 / 1704.03910v2 — b = 0, 30° ≤ l ≤ 330° 에서 10° 간격으로 gNFW 템플릿을 옮겨 DM 스펙트럼과 함께 맞추고, 신호를 유효 배경 b_eff 에 대한 비율 f 로 나타내 평면 맞춤의 16% 만이 넘는 값 δf_GP 를 계통 오차로 씀. 60개 GDE 모형, 주성분 분석, ‘one-sided 1σ’, δN_sig,syst 식은 없어도 됨. 1704.03910v2 9.1 이 한 문장으로 요약한 Calore 등의 방법만 옮기고 29 와 22 가 없으면 오답.

question: According to arXiv:1411.4647v2, annihilation into pairs of on-shell Higgs bosons can fit the Fermi GeV excess. Under which condition is the fit good, and what are the best-fit dark matter mass, annihilation cross section, χ² and p-value for this channel? How does the paper explain that the fit is good although the dark matter mass is more than twice as large as for the other channels?
reference_answer: The fit is good provided the two Higgs bosons are produced almost at rest, i.e. the dark matter mass lies just above m_h. Best fit: m_χ = 125.7 (+3.1/−0) GeV, ⟨σv⟩ = 5.33 (±0.68) × 10⁻²⁶ cm³ s⁻¹, χ²_min = 29.5, p-value 0.13. The paper's explanation, given where it discusses hidden-sector mediators, is that hh behaves like a cascade channel: a Higgs boson at rest decays mostly to b b̄, and each b quark then carries only m_h/2, so the heavy dark matter mass does not spoil the fit.

question: arXiv:2610.26648v1 states that, in addition to its baseline dwarf-spheroidal limits, which include a likelihood term for the stellar-kinematic uncertainties of the J-factors, it also derives limits with the J-factors fixed at their central values. By what factor do the combined 95% CL upper limits on ⟨σv⟩ for the b b̄ channel change when the J-factors are fixed in this way?

items.anchor: fixed at their adopted central values

reference_answer: The paper does not say. It states only that limits with the J-factors fixed at their adopted central values are also derived for comparison, with the same SED likelihood scans and dark matter parameter grids; no such limit, ratio or curve is reported. question: In arXiv:2112.09706v2, which best-fit dark matter mass and annihilation cross section are obtained when the Galactic Center excess spectrum is fitted with annihilation into τ⁺τ⁻?
reference_answer: No τ⁺τ⁻ fit exists in this paper. Citing the high-energy tail of the excess, the authors restrict themselves to three channels (b b̄, hh and ZZ) and defer a broader survey of Standard Model final states to later work, so there is no best-fit mass or cross section for τ⁺τ⁻.

b b-bar cross section of the abstract, another channel

tau tau best-fit mass of arXiv:2610.26648v1, another paper

does not present a b b-bar value, or a value from another paper, as the tau+ tau- result

accept_note: found = false 와 함께 ‘이 논문은 b b̄, hh, ZZ 세 채널만 맞추고 τ⁺τ⁻ 는 맞추지 않았다’는 취지면 정답. b b̄ 의 값(≈ 40 GeV, (1–2)×10⁻²⁶ cm³ s⁻¹)을 참고로 덧붙이는 것은 괜찮지만 τ⁺τ⁻ 의 답으로 내면 오답. 다른 논문의 τ⁺τ⁻ 값을 이 논문의 결과로 내도 오답.

question: Di Mauro and Winkler tested the dark matter interpretation of the Galactic Center excess with a multimessenger analysis that combines Fermi-LAT observations of dwarf spheroidal galaxies with AMS-02 antiproton and positron data. Among their dwarf galaxies, Reticulum II is detected with the highest test statistic. What post-trials (global) significance does the paper give for the Reticulum II signal?
reference_answer: None is given. For Reticulum II the paper reports only local (pre-trials) numbers: TS ≈ 10, p = 2.2×10⁻³ (4.4×10⁻³), about 2.8σ (2.6σ) for b b̄ (τ⁺τ⁻), which is less than the TS of 25 that the Fermi-LAT catalogs require. It then checks these against the same analysis run on 100 random sky directions per region (68% and 95% containment bands), without turning the result into a post-trials significance.

wrong_numbers.label: local (pre-trials) significance for b b-bar, not a post-trials value
local (pre-trials) significance for tau tau, not a post-trials value

by_hand: says that the paper gives no post-trials (global) significance for Reticulum II
does not present 2.8 sigma or 2.6 sigma, or a number of its own, as a post-trials value

accept_note: found = false 와 함께 ‘논문은 local(pre-trials) 값만 준다’는 취지면 정답. 2.8σ(2.6σ), TS ≈ 10, p 값을 pre-trials 값이라고 밝혀 덧붙이는 것은 괜찮음. 이를 post-trials 값으로 내거나, 시행 횟수(dSph 48개, 무작위 방향 100개)로 스스로 환산한 값을 논문의 값처럼 내면 오답.

notes.evidence: 4.2(6,503자). 한 번에 나옴. anchor 는 초안(questions_eval_draft.jsonl)에서 이미 검사된 것.
notes.abstract: 불가능. 초록은 dSph 에서 유의한 신호를 찾지 못했다는 것까지만 말함.

question: For the effective four-body annihilation channels 4b, 4τ and 2b2τ of arXiv:2610.26648v1 (direct annihilation into the four-body final state, without an on-shell mediator), what are the best-fit dark matter mass, annihilation cross section and minimum χ² of the fit to the Galactic Center excess, and which of the three channels fits best?
reference_answer: 4b: m_χ = 67.4 GeV, ⟨σv⟩ = 2.5×10⁻²⁶ cm³ s⁻¹, χ² = 27.92. 4τ: 16.6 GeV, 6.7×10⁻²⁷ cm³ s⁻¹, χ² = 24.29. 2b2τ: 35.1 GeV, 1.8×10⁻²⁶ cm³ s⁻¹, χ² = 35.13. Each fit has 12 degrees of freedom, so the effective 4τ channel gives the lowest χ² (its best-fit point nevertheless lies above the dwarf-spheroidal limit).

question: In the hadronic model of the Fermi bubbles of arXiv:1407.7905v1, which spectrum of cosmic-ray protons reproduces the gamma-ray data — give the functional form, the spectral index and the cutoff energy — and how much energy in cosmic-ray protons above 1 GeV does the model require, for which reference gas density?
reference_answer: A power law in momentum with an exponential cutoff, dn/dp ∝ p⁻ⁿ exp(−pc/E_cut), with n = 2.13 ± 0.01 (stat) +0.15/−0.52 (syst) and E_cut = 14 ± 7 (stat) +6/−13 (syst) TeV. The total energy in cosmic-ray protons above 1 GeV is (3.5 ± 0.1 (stat) +4.7/−3.0 (syst)) × 10⁵⁵ erg × (0.01 cm⁻³/n_H), i.e. for a reference gas density of n_H = 0.01 cm⁻³.

proton cutoff energy

total energy, the power of ten

wrong_numbers.label: electron index of the inverse-Compton model, the other model
electron cutoff of the inverse-Compton model, the other model
energy in electrons of the inverse-Compton model

by_hand: functional form: a power law in momentum with an exponential cutoff
the total energy is 3.5e55 erg for n_H = 0.01 cm^-3 (it scales as 0.01 cm^-3 / n_H)
the values are those of the hadronic model, not of the inverse-Compton model

accept_note: 필수: 운동량의 멱법칙에 지수형 cutoff(dn/dp ∝ p⁻ⁿ e^(−pc/E_cut)), n = 2.13, E_cut = 14 TeV, 1 GeV 위 양성자의 총 에너지 3.5×10⁵⁵ erg(기준 밀도 n_H = 0.01 cm⁻³; 0.01 cm⁻³/n_H 에 비례). 오차는 없어도 됨. IC 모형의 전자 값(n = 2.17, E_cut = 1.25 TeV, 1.0×10⁵² erg)을 답하면 오답. 부록 B.3 의 예시 맞춤(p^−2.1, 13.7 TeV)만 답하면 총 에너지가 없으므로 오답.

question: According to arXiv:1503.01773v2, once dark-sector cascades with any combination of hierarchical and degenerate decay steps are allowed, what is the shape of the region of the (m_χ, ⟨σv⟩) plane in which a given Standard Model final state can fit the Galactic Center excess, and by which two scaling relations between ⟨σv⟩ and m_χ is that region bounded?
reference_answer: The best fits fill a triangle in the m_χ–⟨σv⟩ plane. Its two edges are the power laws ⟨σv⟩ ∝ m_χ and ⟨σv⟩ ∝ m_χ^1.3. (A degenerate step doubles the preferred mass and the cross section together, which gives the linear edge; the steeper edge is the approximate power law that the best fits follow as hierarchical steps are added.)

by_hand: the other boundary is linear: the cross section is proportional to m_chi (exponent 1)

accept_note: 필수: 삼각형 영역, 경계는 ⟨σv⟩ ∝ m_χ 와 ⟨σv⟩ ∝ m_χ^1.3. degenerate 단계가 질량과 단면적을 함께 두 배로 만든다는 설명, k⟨σv⟩ 로 다시 그리면 모든 채널이 같은 삼각형이 된다는 것은 없어도 됨. 지수 1.3 만 답하고 선형 경계가 없으면 오답.

notes.evidence: 4.1(12,060자), 또는 6(3,239자). 두 곳 모두 삼각형 영역과 그 두 경계(∝ m_χ, ∝ m_χ^1.3)를 적음. 각각 한 번에 나옴. 3 에는 지수 1.3 의 멱법칙만 나오고 삼각형 영역은 나오지 않음. anchor 는 2026-11-17 read_section 으로 LaTeX 원문에서 확인함(위치는 eval.check 로 확인할 것).
